minimum_evidence: Named human rights-holder(s), evidence of authority, scope of approval
Source identifier, immutable original, parent-child changes, hashes, provenance notes
Separate text, software, data/examples, marks, general principles; selected licence per object
Approved controlling-language rule or co-equal language conflict rule
Independent reviewer identity, competence, scope, conflict statement, signed findings
Qualified counsel, jurisdiction(s), exact version/hash and written scope/outcome
Reviewer not implementer; source hash, commands, findings, negative tests
Data minimisation, retention/deletion protocol, role access, threat model
Clause map, glossary, independent bilingual review, variance log, hashes
Signed or separately retained digest outside package/system under review
Authorised branch/commit/PR URL; checks; reviewer decision; merge/release hash
Named deployed version, environment, timestamp, cases, logs, access controls, independent witness
